artworks.title: Stag Hunt near a Pool
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Roelandt Savery
artworks.description: The image features a view at eye level into a densely detailed forest. The scene shows twisting tree trunks, canopies, roots, grasses, and a reflective pond. The artwork is rendered with intricate lines, cross-hatching, and a monochromatic color palette of black, white, and grey. The background fades to emphasize the detailed elements in the foreground.

artworks.title: Five Busts
artworks.description: The image consists of five side-profile portrait sketches of different individuals. In the top row, two adults are depicted. The woman on the left has her hair gathered back with curls around her face and is shown from the shoulders up, wearing a dress with puffed sleeves. Opposite her, the man to the right is drawn from slightly below the shoulders up, with short, curly hair and is dressed in a high-collared coat. The second row features two children, each with short hair and shown from the waist up. The child on the left has softer, chin-length hair with loose curls and wears a dress with a simple neckline. The child on the right has cropped hair and is clad in attire with a visible collar. At the bottom, there is a sketch of a young child with shoulder-length curly hair seen from the chest up, wearing a simple garment. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the detailed linework of the portraits against the neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: Nude with Outstretched Arm
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a standing person in a relaxed pose. The person faces away from the viewer, showing the back of their body. The right arm is extended to the side, and the left arm hangs down. The head is slightly turned to the right. The person has an updo hairstyle. The figure is nude. The sketch is on a plain background with no surrounding objects. The image has a sepia-toned appearance.

artworks.title: Shepherd with Flock
artworks.description: The image features an elevated perspective overlooking a countryside scene with a shepherd and a flock of sheep. The horizon line is suggested by a light gradient, separating the sky from the landscape. The scene is depicted in a sketch-like style with detailed lines creating textures in the grass and foliage. The color palette consists of shades of brown and sepia, giving the image a vintage quality. Closest to us are patches of earth and grass, leading to the shepherd and his flock on a rise. The landscape recedes into the distance where a lone tree stands against the pale sky.

artworks.title: Etow oh Koam, King of the River Nation
artworks.artist: Pierre Simon II after John Verelst
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a relaxed pose with a staff. They have long, dark hair tied back, a distinctive tattoo on their forehead and cheek, loose-fitting clothing belted at the waist, moccasin-style footwear, a robe over their shoulders and a sheathed weapon hanging from their belt. Dense foliage and a turtle are around them. Two faint figures and more forest scenery are in the background.

artworks.title: King Richard I
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man. He is depicted from the chest up, facing forward with a serious expression. He has a long face, a pointed nose, and curly hair flowing around his neck. The man wears a crown with ornate designs and fleur-de-lis motifs, and he is dressed in armor on one shoulder with a draped cloak. Surrounding the portrait is an intricate circular frame. Below it is a plaque inscribed with "K. RICHARD I." In the background, there is a textured pattern, and below the plaque is a scene showing people interacting by a waterfront with ships and a castle in the background.

artworks.title: Mulld:Sake (Portrait of John Cottington)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in an exaggerated pose, holding two pipes emitting smoke. He has a mustached face, wears a feathered hat, and elaborate period clothing. The background features a cityscape with buildings emitting smoke.

artworks.title: Narcissus
artworks.artist: Robert T. Stothard after Thomas Stothard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in an activity. The figures are gathered closely, with one leaning forward as if to examine something on the ground. Each figure has distinct expressions and varied postures that suggest an interaction or shared moment. The scene is set in a forest-like environment, with trees surrounding the figures. Shadowing and detailed linework emphasize the depth, giving a three-dimensional effect to the figures and the scene. The attire of the individuals is classical. The composition and style evoke elegance and a sense of narrative captured in this monochromatic depiction.

artworks.title: Johannes Hoornbeeck
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the upper half of his body. The man is slightly turned to the right with his head facing the viewer in a three-quarter view. He has a mustache and short curly hair, wearing a dark cloak with ornate sleeves and a white collar. He is holding a closed book in his left hand. The background has a textured pattern with no distinct objects. At the bottom, text identifies the individual as "Ioannes Hoornbeeck."

artworks.title: Summer Evening (Soirée d'été)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a woman's body, reclining on a wicker chair or bench. She has her eyes closed and appears relaxed. She has curly hair and is wearing a detailed garment with a bow and floral decoration near the neckline, along with a dark scarf or shawl. Surrounding her is a body of water and lush greenery.

artworks.title: Cover, Yvette Guilbert
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person drawn in profile, capturing the upper half of the body. The person is standing with their head slightly tilted upward. Facial features include a nose and closed mouth, with short curly hair. The individual wears a garment, possibly with short sleeves. No accessories or objects are visible. The background is plain, with the text "Yvette Guilbert Drawn by H. de Toulouse Lautrec" around the sketch, and "Yvette Guilbert" as a signature beneath the drawing.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The illustration shows three-quarters of a woman's body, from her waist up. She is standing with her body slightly turned to the side, her head thrown back, and long hair flowing down her back. She is wearing a dress with puffed sleeves and long gloves that cover her arms up to just above the elbow. The background is an off-white surface with the name "Yvette Guilbert" written in cursive across it, as well as the signature "Flautres" in the lower right corner. A simple sketch of a musical instrument or object is in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: A Luncheon Party
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of five women seated around a table and one man standing behind them. The women wear hats and dresses with fur collars, and some wear necklaces. One woman appears to be smoking, with a smoke trail above a holder on the table. The man standing wears a suit and tie with a pencil mustache. The background has a mirror reflecting the man, textured walls, and hats hanging on hooks.

artworks.title: Two Cows under a Tree
artworks.description: The image features a scene showing two cows and a tree. One cow is standing in the center, while another is lying down slightly to the right. A tree provides shade for the lying cow. In the background, there are hills or mountains, a body of water, and trees. The artwork is characterized by fine, detailed lines creating texture and depth, with a black and white color palette emphasizing contrast. The sky has thin clouds depicted with delicate horizontal linework.

artworks.title: King Richard III
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Banck after Edward Lutterell
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person identified as King Richard III. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to the side. The king has long, wavy hair and a serious expression with prominent features such as a long nose and a firm, slightly downturned mouth. He is wearing a garment with a fur collar and a chain of office across his chest. A crown is on his head, and the portrait is set within an elaborate decorative frame featuring floral and geometric patterns. A coat of arms is displayed beneath the portrait, topped with a smaller royal crown. The background has intricate etching patterns.

artworks.title: The Royal Family of the Stuarts
artworks.description: The image shows five oval portraits of historical figures from the Stuart royal family. The portraits depict King James the First, King Charles the First, Queen Anne, King Charles the Second, and King James the Second. Each portrait shows the bust of the person facing slightly to the side. The portraits are within oval frames with the names of each person inscribed on a ribbon at the base of the frame. A decorative border underlines the portraits and contains a poetic verse related to the reign of the Stuarts. The background consists of evenly spaced lines forming the backdrop of each portrait.

artworks.title: Pierre Guerin
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man, visible from the chest up and positioned slightly to the side while looking directly at the viewer. His facial features include large, expressive eyes, a straight nose, and a slightly downturned mouth. His hair is short, curly, and dark, styled back from his forehead. He is dressed in formal attire, with a high-collared, buttoned shirt accompanied by a cravat, and a dark coat over a lighter vest. No jewelry or objects are present. The background is plain, with a faint, shaded area behind the figure on one side. The image features a signature or text in the bottom left corner of the shaded area.

artworks.title: Wounded French Attacked by a Cosack
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures engaged in combat. There is a tree with thick branches on the right side, with its leaves creating a canopy. In the center, soldiers and horses are in a skirmish, some on horseback and one figure drawing a weapon. A fallen horse and rider are on the ground. The landscape is mountainous with rocky cliffs and tall coniferous trees. The style is detailed with intricate use of line and shading, with a monochromatic color palette of black and white.

artworks.title: Game of Checkers (La partie de dames)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on china paper mounted on tan wove paper, graphite tick marks drawn on mounting paper and paint indicate a later mounting
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene featuring three figures around a table. The artwork depicts a seated individual engaged in a game or activity with another seated figure, while a third figure stands and observes. The setting is richly detailed, with an ornate patterned wallpaper in a golden hue providing a backdrop for the scene. The figures are rendered in a stylized manner using a limited palette dominated by shades of burgundy, teal, and ochre. Seating elements feature floral patterns that match the aesthetic of the period depicted. This is in the style of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec, characterized by bold outlines and a focus on interactions in intimate settings.

artworks.title: Josiah Wedgewood, Esq.
artworks.artist: John Taylor Wedgwood after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man in an ornate frame. He is depicted from the shoulders up with his head turned slightly to the left. The man has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and a gentle expression. His hair, styled in 18th-century fashion, is arranged in voluminous curls pulled back. He wears formal attire - a dark coat over a white shirt with a frilled cravat. The composition includes intricate ceramic vases and cups below the portrait, suggesting a connection to pottery or craftsmanship. The background is a plain, lightly speckled paper, giving an aged appearance, with printed text identifying the subject as "Josiah Wedgwood Esq. F.R.S. & F.S.A."

artworks.title: Church in an Inlet with Rowboat in the Foreground
artworks.description: The image shows a waterway scene with structures on the shores. The horizon is low in the composition, with small sailing boats visible on the water. The artwork is an etching with intricate linear details and cross-hatching for texture and shading. The color palette is monochrome, with sepia and black shades. A small boat with figures sails on the water, leading towards a larger sailboat. In the distance, people are near a building, potentially a church, with a tall tower. Birds are in the sky.

artworks.title: Houses on an Inlet
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a scene by the water's edge. The horizon is low in the image, where the sky meets the water. Small boats are visible in the distance, and nearby, there are buildings, including a tower, and leafy trees. The etching uses fine lines for texture and shading, creating detail in the clouds, water, and structures. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black and white for depth and contrast, as is typical in etchings.

artworks.title: Martyrdom of Saint Sebastian
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.2 × 14.3 cm (4 × 5 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an archery event. The image features a person tied to a tree, a man aiming a crossbow at the target, another man standing nearby, and a figure holding a staff. In the background, there are hills, trees, a structure, and two small human figures. The drawing is sketched with lines and hatching for texture and shading.

artworks.title: This is my Beloved Son
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a slightly bent posture, one leg forward, and arms crossed over their chest. The person has long, wavy hair covering most of their facial features. They are wearing a simple, long garment and are barefoot on a textured surface with scattered leaves nearby. A bird is flying above the person's head in a sky filled with swirling clouds. The background features a landscape with a body of water and gently rolling hills.
